name: Hope Town Inn & Marina
primary_cta: Check room rates (Vertical Booking hand-off); Book a slip (Dockwa hand-off) for boaters; sticky strip switches with the section
brand_truth: The harbourside estate beside the Elbow Reef Lighthouse, where boats and guests arrive at the same dock.
buyer: US East Coast couples and families planning an Abaco trip months ahead on a phone; yacht and sportfish owners and captains crossing from Florida checking slip limits and power.

direction.why: Two arrivals, one harbour: the split makes the brand truth literal and keeps their own photography full height; salt white with slate ink and a flamingo accent echoes Hope Town's pastel cottages and striped lighthouse.

big_idea: Two ways in: screen 1 switches By ferry (party size 1 to 8 lights the nine stays that fit, the chosen stay appears as a photo card on the harbour half, Check rates for it on Vertical Booking) or By boat (LOA verdict against slips to 125 ft and moorings to 45 ft, specs, Book a slip on Dockwa).
concept_type: booking: stay finder by party size handing off to Vertical Booking, slip check handing off to Dockwa, bar, Johnny's Cay, getting here
tier_why: Their own aerial of the harbour says more than a 3D ocean; fixed split with crossfades.

pitch_line: Your booking engines are good; your site makes guests and captains dig for them. This one asks 'by ferry or by boat?' and gets each to the right booking in two taps.
assumptions: Vertical Booking opens on the property; the guest picks the stay there (no room deep link known)
Stay thumbnails are their 395x300 Wix images seen on /abacos-bahamas-resort; full-resolution photos to request at launch
notes: Gen-2 rebuild by scheduled site worker 2026-11-21 (claimed after another worker released it out of budget; reused its audit and the own-photo gallery). No new research calls. BLIND: screenshots used crops of the Lovable gallery screenshot. qa.mjs 'dead space' blocker on the left 720 px is a false positive: the left half is a sticky full-height photograph (A08 fixed split) that a single full-page screenshot only paints once; stitched viewport captures show it on every screen. Remaining tap-target warning is the shared concept-label button. Plan-gate critic asked for 5 revisions, all applied; scores are its predicted post-fix scores. distinct.mjs: distinct; ground tinted to salt grey after its cream warning.
critic_note: Independent critic, three rounds. Fixed: duplicate slip-check ids, stays too small (added a native-size stay card), tile wraps, section 2 filter conflicting with screen 1 (now a static comparison), harbour/docks crossfade to itself (now a pan), phone fold, honest helper line, Elbow Reef Classic wording, single strip button on stay and marina pages.
